selection: Dense non-transposed 3x3 convolution; groups=1; 8<=OC<=16; IC divisible by 4; B*OH*OW>=4096. Shape-based selection, no vendor checks.
notes: Only nine YOLO convolutions select this kernel. DepthART selects none.
Smaller grids regressed in raw comparisons and retain the existing path.
Model timings measure the recorded graph, excluding camera, preprocessing and presentation.

kernels.method: 8–512 recorded dispatches per submit, scaled by operation count; submit + await sync; 3 warmups, 11 alternating samples per version; median milliseconds per dispatch; GPU timestamps

report.method: Instrument actual example loops with CPU clocks and GPU pass timestamps. Synthetic video; no camera permissions. Warmup frames excluded. Configurations run sequentially; model clock variation prevents interpreting total frame differences as presentation speedups.
report.warning: Do not attribute frame-minus-model time entirely to pre/post shaders: CPU handling, GPU copies, presentation, queue/browser scheduling and callback delivery also contribute. Forced detections include a small diagnostic setup dispatch in postprocessing.
